status: target-neutral-contract; backend implementation and portable admission pending

policy.arithmetic: For an existing array of length L and a supported integer i<0, resolve j=L+i; selection requires 0<=j<L.
policy.positive: Nonnegative replacement and exact-length append retain write-v1 semantics; negative indexes never append or invent fillers.
policy.missing: A negative selector cannot create its required array. An absent root or missing child at that selector retains nested_write_segment_invalid with reason negative_integer.
policy.kinds: Integer selectors require arrays; write strings, including dynamic and quoted negative numeric strings, remain harray keys. Present null and other wrong kinds are never coerced.
policy.snapshot: Evaluate segments left to right once, then RHS once. Resolve each negative position during the isolated structural walk against its encountered post-expression array.
policy.atomicity: Commit the isolated root once on success. Failure discards partial structural creation but preserves completed expression effects.
policy.detachment: Write-v1 detachment of initial input, aggregate RHS, committed binding and returned root remains required.
policy.path: Diagnostic path is the detached prefix of authored evaluated selector values, retaining negative values rather than normalized offsets.
policy.reads: Integer array reads apply the same existing-array arithmetic, return null outside bounds and never create state. Explicit quoted key steps remain keys.
policy.structural_order: Walk left to right: kind conflict, positive gap, negative underflow or negative missing-target failure occurs at the first encountered failing segment.
policy.negative_validation: Negative integers are conditionally valid array selectors, so their existence and lower bound are structural checks after globally invalid selector kinds.
policy.history: Supersede only the blanket rejection of negative integer selectors by permitting existing in-range array positions. Frozen write-v1, map/composition authorities, statuses, digests and historical consumers remain unchanged.
